subtitle: Eight weeks. Intentional training. Your strength.
restoreText: Bench — 100 kg. Conventional deadlift — 155 kg. Base training on current strength.
checkinText: 30 seconds to match training to recovery.
warmupText: 5–8 min easy general warm-up, then 3–5 ramp-up sets. These do not count as working sets.
ceiling: RPE is a ceiling, not a target. Never take singles to failure.
noAlternative: No compatible alternative. Change equipment or discuss limitations with a coach.
swapLoad: Replacement has no measured 1RM: select a safe load manually.
videoLocal: Videos stay on this device, outside JSON backups. Up to 100 MB.
videoError: Select a video up to 100 MB. Check available storage.
emptyLogsText: Log your first set to see your progress here.
demoConfirm: Replace logs and check-ins with three demo weeks? Undo restores current records.
mondayRequired: Cycle must start on a Monday.
formTip: Use 0.95–0.98 after a hard meet or layoff. Range 0.80–1.05.
invalid: Check form values: a number is outside the allowed range.
onboardingText: Your Excel profile is prefilled. Review values and start your cycle.
builderText: 8 weeks with a week-4 deload and reduced volume before finishing.
powerliftingFixed: Exact Excel program: 3 days, Mon / Wed / Fri. Other goals support 2–5 days.
armSafety: Never train through sharp elbow, wrist or humerus pain. Progress slowly.
repeatWeek: Adherence below 60%: consider repeating the week.
reviewText: Compare sleep, RPE, completion and technique over 2–3 weeks. A plateau rarely has a single cause.
greenText: Recovery supports the plan. Monitor technique and RPE.
yellowText: Loads −2.5%, RPE ceiling −0.5; last accessory removed. Second main movement stays.
orangeText: Loads −5%, 1–2 fewer sets. No secondary accessories, heavy singles or max tests.
redText: No heavy work. Rest or easy walking. Consult a physician or sports physiotherapist for persistent pain.
shortSleep: Sleep below 5.5 h: at least yellow.
veryShortSleep: Sleep below 4.5 h: at least orange.
sleepDebt: Three short nights: reduce accessory volume this week.
underEating: Low energy or protein for two days. Restore adequate nutrition.
stopPain: Stop signal: pain, dizziness or severe weakness.
mildPain: Mild pain: reduce load and avoid painful movements.
disclaimer: General fitness information, not medical advice. Stop heavy work for sharp or worsening pain, dizziness or severe weakness and consult a physician or sports physiotherapist. Under 18: adult or coach supervision. Results are not guaranteed.
immediateReduce: RPE above ceiling or technique deteriorated: reduce next set by 2.5–5%.
halalNote: Halal: pork excluded; verify certification of other foods.
foodApprox: Nutrition values are approximate. Grains are dry, meat is cooked. Check labels and allergens.
dietUnavailable: Not enough foods match restrictions. Update preferences or allergies.
nutritionTiming: 2–3 h before: carbs and protein. After: a regular protein-containing meal. During: water; carbs as tolerated for long sessions.
calorieSafety: Deficit capped at 20% TDEE. No aggressive cuts. Formula is a starting estimate; adjust from weight averages.
deleteConfirm: Delete entry? You can undo this action.
forecastDisclaimer: Range is a scenario, not a promise. Training quality, sleep and technique matter more than attractive numbers.
fastTrend: Weight is changing faster than selected pace. Review calories.
slowTrend: Weight is changing slower than selected pace. Compare 2–3 weeks.
plateau1: 1. Sleep and recovery: compare 2–3 week averages.
plateau2: 2. Completion and RPE: reduce volume for persistent fatigue.
plateau3: 3. Technique: compare videos before adding load.
testSafety: Check rack, spotters and federation rules. Order: squat → paused bench → conventional deadlift. Rest 4–7+ min. No testing with pain, dizziness or lost control.
testSpacing: Keep at least 48 h after recovery. Reschedule if the gym is closed in January.
testWarning: Slow or failed attempt: never chase a heavier load.
carryCycle: Start next cycle with successful maxes
carryConfirm: Finish cycle and apply successful maxes? Export a backup first to preserve history.
testBlocked: Orange / red readiness: postpone testing; individual lifts can be skipped.
scienceNote: Research supports principles, but does not prove this exact table maximizes 8-week gains.
importConfirm: Replace all data with this backup? Undo is available.
importError: Invalid backup format. Current data is preserved.
resetConfirm: Reset all data? Export a backup first.
storageError: Could not read or save data. Check device storage and export a backup.
installHint: Use browser menu: Install app or Add to Home Screen. Open needed sections once for offline use.
guideText: Follow the plan, log your sets and prioritize recovery.
noSchedule: No compatible exercises. Review limitations and equipment.
injuryConflict: No compatible replacement for current limitations. Skip it and discuss with a coach.
sessionLimit: Session may exceed selected time: remove final accessory exercises.
manualMetrics: Track specialized movement strength by actual weight and reps in the log.
plateauSleep: Sleep: reduce workload if below baseline
plateauRpe: Average RPE deviation: reduce volume for a persistent increase
plateauTechnique: Sets with lost technique: review video and reduce load
specialStrength: Reference load for 8–12 reps in a specialized movement, not a 1RM. Progress under the RPE ceiling.
